title: I Had To Move Her Inside..
description:
I Had To Move Her Inside..

I've had to move Multy indoors due to her health not being so good. She is very underweight, and was continuing to drop in weight which was a big concern. Weighing only 720g and still dropping in weight means that she is not well enough to stay out during the Winter. Only healthy animals should be kept outdoors during the cold season. She also did not move from the hutch unless she was hungry and came down for food, so she was not showing an interest in social interaction with the others. She is still doing ok, and after many vet trips these last few months there is nothing obvious to suggest she has an illness. I figured that bringing her indoors would benefit her the most. If she does show signs of being lonely or depressed, I will have to look into other options, but for now she keeps content. I also moved her into a C&C cage the size of the table, so she has more room :)
